name: Rachel Studio Client-Facing Process
purpose: Explain Rachel Hernandez Studio to sellers without exposing the technical machinery.
core_explanation: Most listings are prepared for distribution. Rachel Hernandez Studio prepares a property to be understood.

public_positioning.recommended_phrase: Rachel Hernandez Studio pairs a private editorial production process with the reach of Sotheby's International Realty.

client_process_steps.client_meaning: Rachel learns the property deeply before presenting it.
The property receives a story, not generic listing copy.
The property receives a dedicated digital presentation built for that property alone.
The launch connects Studio-level positioning with Sotheby's International Realty reach and property-specific search strategy.
The public presentation stays current while the property is on the market.

client_receives: SEO title, description, image text, and structured data planning
source and backlink strategy where relevant
private_machinery_rule: Do not expose MCP, Cloudflare, GitHub, Cloudinary, Remotion, D1, or agent orchestration in client-facing process language.
